verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an API reachable via access tokens, a plugin API and an MCP server, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. API existence alone does not count as an explorable, runnable reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
